purpose: AXI write response with SLVERR on TX FIFO full
code:
always_comb begin
    bresp_n = 2'b00;
    tx_fifo_push = 1'b0;
    if (wr_fire) begin
        unique case (wr_addr)
            TXDATA_ADDR: begin
                if (!tx_full) begin
                    tx_fifo_push = 1'b1;
                    tx_fifo_wdata = wdata[7:0];
                end else begin
                    bresp_n = 2'b10; // SLVERR
                end
            end
        endcase
    end
end

purpose: UART RX byte injection task for testbench
Reset behavior for CSRs and outputs
RX FIFO push with overrun handling

code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
iverilog -g2012 -o sim.out \
  rtl/pkg/uart_pkg.sv \
  rtl/modules/fifo_sync.sv \
  rtl/modules/baud_gen.sv \
  rtl/modules/uart_tx.sv \
  rtl/modules/uart_rx.sv \
  rtl/modules/axi_lite_regs.sv \
  rtl/axi_uart_top.sv \
  tb/axi_uart_tb.sv
vvp sim.out

module axi_uart_top #(
    parameter int ADDR_W = 16,
    parameter int DATA_W = 32,
    parameter int FIFO_DEPTH = 16,
    parameter int OVERSAMPLE = 16
) (
    input  logic clk, rst_n,
    input  logic [ADDR_W-1:0] s_axi_awaddr, s_axi_araddr,
    input  logic s_axi_awvalid, s_axi_wvalid, s_axi_wstrb, s_axi_bready,
    input  logic s_axi_arvalid, s_axi_rready,
    input  logic [DATA_W-1:0] s_axi_wdata,
    input  logic uart_rx,
    output logic s_axi_awready, s_axi_wready, s_axi_bvalid,
    output logic s_axi_arready, s_axi_rvalid,
    output logic [1:0] s_axi_bresp, s_axi_rresp,
    output logic [DATA_W-1:0] s_axi_rdata,
    output logic uart_tx, irq
);
